title: Visualization canvas fallbacks, modal stacking, and keyboard-first navigation for Console charts & tables
creator: Nora Patel
description: Scope: Design and prototype resilient behaviors for embedded visualizations (dashboards, cost views, rollouts) under constrained rendering environments and across major browsers. Solve for chart/canvas failures, table virtualization keyboard navigation, stacked modal UX on small viewports, and consistent cross-browser micro-interactions. Deliverables: Figma prototype, annotated spec for engineering, acceptance criteria, and test matrix for BrowserStack/real devices.
acceptance_criteria: Charts degrade gracefully: when WebGL/canvas is unavailable or produces rendering glitches, visuals fall back to SVG or pre-computed static assets without layout jump
Table virtualization maintains keyboard focus order and ARIA attributes when rows are recycled; screen reader order preserved

Modal stacking behaviour defined: persistent top-bar actions remain accessible, underlying modals dim but keep accessible focus context; small viewport stacking limits to two with clear escape affordances
Cross-browser visual parity within reasonable tolerances on Chrome, Firefox, Safari (mac/iOS), and Edge; documented exceptions with mitigation steps
Prototype reviewed and approved by Eng + PM; one engineering spike created (ENG-45022) and PR opened with basic polyfills and CSS variables
QA test matrix and BrowserStack screenshots attached; regression tests added to console-e2e-suite
comments: 2026-01-12 Nora Patel: Initial ticket created after design review. Core problems observed in user sessions: charts flicker in Safari when resizing, large tables lose keyboard focus when virtualized rows unmount. Proposed investigation: build two Figma variants (canvas-first + svg-fallback) and a small in-browser prototype for keyboard virtualization behavior.

2026-01-18 Miguel Alvarez: Built prototype for modal stacking patterns. Decided modal stack limit of 2 on <=720px width, with a persistent breadcrumb-style pill to return to previous modal. Added focus-trap behavior and visible z-index layering rules. See Figma: figma.com/proto/RW-console-stack-2026

2026-01-22 Jamal Rivera (Eng): Ran spike on Safari WebGL oddities. Findings: Safari iOS tends to drop canvas content when memory pressure is high; fallback to SVG or cached PNG needed for stable UX. Created ENG-45022 to implement canvas fallback mechanism and requested spec for server-side static thumbnail generation.

2026-01-25 Priya Mehta (PM): Prioritized keyboard navigation fixes for tables — flagged as high customer impact for accessibility compliance. Recommend shipping keyboard-first improvements in first iteration with progressive enhancement for virtualization optimizations.

2026-01-29 Miguel Alvarez: Updated Figma to include keyboard state overlays and focus outlines. Added example keyboard flows for row selection, inline actions, and cell editing. Note: visual density maintained; outline styles use system focus color token to avoid contrast regressions.

2026-02-01 QA: Added BrowserStack screenshots showing Safari iOS canvas fallback and Edge text rendering variance. Logged two visual regressions (BG-981, BG-982) — attached below. Requested clarity on animation durations for chart redraws to avoid jank on low-power devices.

2026-02-02 Nora Patel: Design review completed with Eng and PM. Acceptance criteria refined. Next steps: finalize annotated spec, handoff meeting with ENG (2026-02-04), and link engineering spike (ENG-45022) to this ticket as a dependency. Miguel to open PR with minimal polyfills and CSS variables as implementation starting point.
